name: Securities Market Report Header 3
definition: Provides the details of the Order Book report header.

ReportingEntity.name: Reporting Entity
ReportingEntity.definition: Identification of the venue which generates the report.

ReportingPeriod.name: Reporting Period
ReportingPeriod.definition: Date or date range the report relates to.

ISIN.name: ISIN
ISIN.definition: ISIN code of the financial instrument the report relates to.

SubmissionDateTime.name: Submission Date Time
SubmissionDateTime.definition: Date and time of the report originally submitted by the reporting entity when the file is generated for submission to their reporting authority.

MessagePagination.name: Message Pagination
MessagePagination.definition: Page number of the message (within the report) and continuation indicator to indicate that the report is to continue or that the message is the last page of the report.

NumberRecords.name: Number Records
NumberRecords.definition: Indicates the number of records in the page.
